criteria.criterion: A scheduled Mercari job completes through the real stack, and its listings (with sale dates for sold ones) are readable from the API.
criteria.plannedImplementation: No production code change is required for this criterion beyond AC-2's fix; it is a proof exercise of the existing #40/#41/#42/#43/#44/#45 pipeline. A throwaway SQLite database, Azurite, the AIOWebScraper Functions host and worker (patched locally and uncommitted to launch Chrome off-screen), and the ETL Api + Etl processes are started per docs/running-locally.md. A Mercari job is created via POST /api/jobs (not /run), the scheduler (JobQueueingWorker) picks it up on its next tick and enqueues a run, ScrapeRunService executes active+sold search, price-band slicing, item-detail fetch and persistence, and the results are read back via GET /api/scrape/jobs/{jobId}/listings.
criteria.plannedVerification: Manual live run, recorded directly in the PR body with: listings stored per direction (active/sold), price bands fetched, detail pages fetched, and how many sold listings received a SoldDate. Not expressible as an automated dotnet test (see test-plan.json rationale).

criteria.criterion: A configured Scraper:SessionReference is not sent with Mercari fetches (unit test on HttpScrapeClient).
criteria.plannedImplementation: HttpScrapeClient.StartJob currently always passes _options.SessionReference into ScrapeJobRequest. Add a private helper that omits the session reference when the target URL's host is a Mercari host (www.mercari.com), so ScrapeJobRequest.SessionReference is null (and therefore omitted from the JSON body by the existing JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull) for Mercari fetches, while non-Mercari (eBay) fetches keep sending it exactly as before.
criteria.plannedVerification: HttpScrapeClientTests.Should_not_send_session_reference_for_mercari_fetches configures a non-null SessionReference, calls GetPageHtml with a https://www.mercari.com/... URL against a stub HttpMessageHandler, and asserts the captured api/NewJob request body's JSON property names do not include SessionReference (mirroring the existing Should_pin_the_new_job_wire_field_names test's assertion style). The existing Should_pin_the_new_job_wire_field_names test (an eBay URL) is left unchanged and continues to assert SessionReference IS sent, proving the fix is Mercari-specific, not global.

comparisonObservation.firstObservation: A Mercari target URL omits SessionReference from the outgoing NewJob request even when one is configured.
comparisonObservation.whenHeldValueAbsent: A non-Mercari (eBay) target URL still sends the configured SessionReference exactly as before.

criteria.criterion: The runbook lets a fresh reader start the stack.
criteria.plannedImplementation: docs/running-locally.md documents, in order: starting Azurite, starting the AIOWebScraper Functions host and worker (including the off-screen browser requirement and its local.settings.json setting names, no secret values), starting the ETL Api and Etl processes, the configuration keys each process needs (Scraper:BaseUrl, Scraper:ApiKey, Scraper:SessionReference, ContentStore:ConnectionString, ContentStore:ContainerName, Database:ConnectionString, Schedule:TickMinutes, Schedule:RefreshIntervalHours, Scrape:MaxPages, Scrape:CollectSold, Scrape:MaxBandsPerDirection, Scrape:MaxConcurrentDetailFetches, Scrape:MaxDetailFetchesPerRun, Scrape:MaxDetailFetchAttempts) by name only, and how to create and observe a job through POST /api/jobs.
criteria.plannedVerification: Reviewed for completeness against the actual commands used for the live run in this PR; a fresh reader following the doc top-to-bottom can reach a completed job without consulting anything else. Documentation criterion, verified by review rather than by an automated test.
